records.title: Reduction of Noetic coverage to jointly-surjective coverage
records.statement: Under the conservative Noetic Topos axioms, J_noe equals the topology whose covering sieves contain a jointly-surjective family.
assumptions: Definitions and axioms of Sections 3 through 6 of the conservative source
Sieve closure under precomposition
records.claim_boundary: This identifies the generated coverage; it does not establish empirical relevance or preserve separate ACBE/RPM provenance.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: The source's Lemma 6.3 already supplies the main reduction.

records.title: ACBE and RPM clauses add only maximal sieves
records.statement: Every sieve satisfying Noe-Cov-2 contains an identity by ACBE reflexivity, and every sieve satisfying Noe-Cov-3 contains an identity because epsilon has section eta. Hence those clauses add no nonmaximal covers; separately they generate the coarsest topology.
assumptions: ACBE reflexivity includes the identity descent map
epsilon_X composed with eta_X is id_X
Sieve closure under precomposition
records.claim_boundary: This is a diagnosis of the present generators. It does not rule out a redesigned colored or marked coverage.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Identity sheafification modalities commute vacuously; noncommutation requires a changed construction.

records.title: Operator norm of a deterministic standard-basis lift
records.statement: For f:X->Y and A_f e_x=e_f(x), the operator norm of A_f is sqrt(max_y |f^{-1}(y)|).
assumptions: The basis vectors are orthonormal
The lift is defined by A_f e_x=e_f(x)
records.claim_boundary: Corrects the inherited norm bound; it says nothing about empirical dynamics or channel contractivity.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Migration disposition remains provisional until Integration Board review even though the replacement formula is standard.

records.title: Counterexample to inherited occupation and projector identities
records.statement: The constant map on two states has an idempotent standard lift A with norm sqrt(2), tr(A* A)=2, and rank(A)=1; A is neither a partial isometry nor an orthogonal projector. Therefore the inherited universal occupation/projector cluster is false.
assumptions: Standard Euclidean inner product
records.claim_boundary: Refutes the stated universal claims only; corrected support/projector statements must be formulated separately.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team

records.title: Current axioms do not imply subcanonicity
records.statement: There is a pullback-closed finite concrete category satisfying the relevant setup whose jointly-surjective topology is not subcanonical: sets of size at most two with injections provide a countermodel.
assumptions: Objects are finite sets of size at most two
Morphisms are injections
Covers contain jointly-surjective families
records.claim_boundary: Shows non-derivability from current axioms; it does not prove every model is non-subcanonical.
counterexample_artifacts: Two-point set covered by its point inclusions with incompatible global injection target
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Use sheafification a_J(yX_i) unless a revised construction proves subcanonicity.

records.title: Normalized orthogonal-projector Gram kernel
records.statement: For common finite rank d>0 orthogonal projectors P_i in one Hilbert space, k(i,j)=tr(P_i P_j)/d is a normalized positive-semidefinite kernel with values in [0,1].
assumptions: All projectors are self-adjoint and idempotent
All have common finite rank d>0
All act on one Hilbert space
records.claim_boundary: Positive semidefinite does not mean strictly positive definite and does not validate latent cognitive subspaces.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Complex quadratic forms require conjugated coefficients.

records.title: Proposed CAS moving-projector capacity specialization
records.statement: A CAS-specific projector code may satisfy the manuscript's projection-capacity bound if a representation realizes every source hypothesis, including the required isometry/intertwining identity.
assumptions: A CAS-specific B:V->W tensor V exists
B*(ell_x tensor u)=sqrt(Lambda)u on each projector image
Lambda>s
All code hypotheses of Proposition 4.1 hold
records.claim_boundary: No capacity bound, engineering capacity, or empirical representational claim is currently established.
counterexample_artifacts: D=d=1 two-codeword counterexample to the weakened transferred assumptions
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: The prior transfer omitted the load-bearing intertwining condition.

records.title: Pairwise-compatible marginals need not glue globally
records.statement: Three binary variables can be pairwise perfectly anticorrelated with matching uniform singleton marginals while admitting no global joint distribution.
assumptions: Three binary variables
Each pair is assigned perfect anticorrelation
records.claim_boundary: Does not rule out gluing under acyclic covers or other sufficient conditions.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team

records.title: Idempotent power for a fixed finite transformation
records.statement: For a function f on an n-element set, f^(n!) is idempotent; more generally, for s in a finite semigroup S, s^(|S|!) is idempotent.
assumptions: One fixed endomorphism or one fixed semigroup element is iterated
records.claim_boundary: Does not apply to arbitrary time-varying sequences of different typed generators.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
